alerts.name: SQL Injection
alerts.evidence: The page response contained a database error string
alerts.description: SQL injection may be possible on the search parameter: untrusted data is concatenated into a database query without parameterization.
alerts.solution: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements and validate input server-side.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.evidence: The response does not include a Content-Security-Policy header
alerts.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
alerts.solution: Configure a Content-Security-Policy header that restricts script and object sources.

alerts.name: X-Frame-Options Header Not Set
alerts.description: X-Frame-Options helps protect against clickjacking by controlling whether the page can be framed.
alerts.solution: Add an X-Frame-Options: DENY header, or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.
